messages:
incident-bot: Pager: [P1] Elevated 5xx + timeouts on Dedicated cluster aurorared-dedicated-prod-1 (tenant: Aurorared). Error rate -> 5xx spike from 0.3% to 18% over the last 6m. Latency tail rising. Link: https://grafana.redwood/aurorared/dedicated/overview :rotating_light:
Sara L: Acked. I'm oncall. starting triage now. anyone else available for quick pairing?
Ken M: I can help for the next 20m then drop to async. What do we know about affected endpoints?
Sara L: Most errors are from /v1/generate (text generation). Gateway 502/504 and backend 5xx (inference-worker). Looking at per-tenant breakdown — 98% of errors map to tenant Aurorared's pool.
Miguel R: I'm seeing a sharp increase in inflight tokens and KV cache evictions on the aurorared workers. GPU mem pressure trending to 94% then OOM-ish evictions.
Anya P: Any noisy-tenant signal? Could be a single client sending very long sequences or huge batch sizes.
Sara L: Logs show repeated requests with seq_length ~ 20480 and batching=16 from the same api_key prefix. Example log:```
2026-03-15T02:33:14Z aurorared-worker-12 ERROR inference: generation failed status=5xx reason=kv_eviction model="gpt-decl-6b" seq_len=20480 batch=16 api_key_prefix=aur-1x2
```
Ira O: That pattern would blow the KV cache and cause catastrophic slowdowns because we spill to CPU and then time out at gateway.
Ken M: Can we identify and throttle that api_key quickly? Is there an API to apply temporary per-key rate limit on Dedicated clusters?
Miguel R: We have a routing policy flag to set request size caps and temporary throttles per-tenant. I'm running the command to enable conservative caps now:```
# set conservative caps for tenant Aurorared
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant aurorared --max_seq_len 4096 --max_batch 4 --temp-throttle 200rps
```
ops-bot: Command accepted. Policy change applying to aurorared-dedicated-prod-1 — expected propagation 30s.
Sara L: While that rolls, I'm scaling up worker pool with 2 extra GPUs to relieve immediate pressure. Triggering scale action:```
redwoodctl cluster scale aurorared-dedicated-prod-1 --add-gpus 2 --reason "mitigation - KV eviction surge"
```
ops-bot: Scale request acknowledged. New nodes will join in ~3m.
Anya P: I've messaged the customer's technical contact (cc: support) to let them know we're mitigating and to ask if they pushed a large batch change or a model update.
Ira O: Observability: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 9% within 90s after caps applied, tail latency still elevated but improving. Good sign.
Ken M: Can we add a temporary fallback route to a lower-memory model variant for that tenant? Should reduce memory churn.
Miguel R: Yes, we have a compatible quantized variant q-gpt-decl-6b. I'm initiating a soft-route for 15% of traffic to fallback:```
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --tenant aurorared --from model=gpt-decl-6b --to model=q-gpt-decl-6b --pct 15
```
ops-bot: Fallback policy applied. Traffic shift in progress.
Sara L: Monitoring dashboards: errors trending down to 4.2% after 6m, tail p95 latency 2.1s -> 1.4s. Need to keep an eye on KV eviction metric and GPU mem over the next 15m.
Anya P: Customer response: "We did a large batch import earlier, didn't realize token lengths would be that high. Thanks for the quick action, please keep us posted."
Ken M: Next steps: keep caps in place, maintain increased pool until stable, audit logs to find offending api_key and follow up with account team for quota/rate-limit rules.
Ira O: I'll create an incident page and note the temporary throttles and fallback routing. Also recommend a conservative guardrail in tenant onboarding to reject sequences > 8k by default.
Sara L: Agreed. I'll run post-incident: verify no residual errors, revert fallback after 30m if stable, and hand off to the after-hours oncall.
Miguel R: All quiet on infra metrics now, 5xx ~1.1%, KV evictions back to baseline. Scaling finished, extra nodes healthy.
Sara L: Handoff: @Ken M will be primary monitor for next hour then @Ira O takes overnight. Documenting timeline in incident doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/incidents/3860002020-aurorared-kv-evictions
Ken M: Copy. I'll keep watch and escalate if any regression. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident status updated -> Mitigated (P2). Follow-up actions: postmortem, tenant quota audit, onboarding guardrail task.
Sara L: Closing thread for live mitigation. We'll draft comms and postmortem tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :heart:
